title: spermacoce saxicola
intro:
Spermacoce saxicola, commonly known as Rock Catanaria, is a plant species that belongs to the Rubiaceae family, characterized by its small, white, or pinkish flowers and hairy leaves.

This plant has been used in traditional medicine to offer various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues.

The therapeutic actions of Spermacoce saxicola include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and cough, as well as its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce pain and swelling.

The bioactive constituents of Spermacoce saxicola include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
